easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.
